system.notes: Pi Imager customisation works on our cards: Wi-Fi, hostname and the login you set on the Imager screen are applied on first boot instead of silently losing the hub.

proxy.notes: Zones and the remote sheet work again: eleven contract handlers were never registered. A device taken out of its last room stays out of it, and a setting taken off it stays off. A television that has just been paired is connected to rather than left for a minute. Playback is no longer claimed for a device the hub cannot see. Faint captions can be read on every surface, in both themes.
